prompt: Which statements about environments are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Environments bundle three things: gates (reviewers), reach (secrets and protection scoped to jobs that name the environment), and a record (deployment history). They are created on demand, never by default, and never leak secrets upward.

options.text: An environment can require reviewers before a job proceeds
A job can read an environment’s secrets without referencing the environment
Protection rules can restrict which branches deploy to the environment
Every repository is created with a `production` environment
Deployment history per environment is visible on its page
